test_get_action_distribution: test get_action_distribution to create a categorical distribution from gym action spaces and PyTorch logits
test_calc_num_logits: test calc_num_logits to compute the number of logits needed for a gym action space
test_sample_actions_log_probs: test sample_actions_log_probs to sample actions and compute their log probabilities from a distribution
